# SectionLabel

The mono micro-label that introduces a run of rows, with an optional note on the right.

## Anatomy

The label on the left, the hint on the right, both on the same baseline.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hint` | `string` | `'', headingLevel, id, children` | A trailing note, rendered one tracking step tighter and one tone lighter. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | — | Renders as a heading at this level when the label introduces a region. Left off, it is a plain label — the reference's own markup, which is right when the list below is not a section of its own. |
| `id` | `string` | — | — |
| `children` *(required)* | `Snippet` | — | — |

## Variants

Plain label, or a real heading at level 2, 3 or 4.

## States

Static.

## Keyboard

Not interactive.

## ARIA

Given `headingLevel` it renders as a heading, so the section joins the document outline and a `List` can point at it with `aria-labelledby`. Left off, it is a plain label — which is right when the rows below are not a section of their own.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
